description: Plaatselijke hoofdstukken en bestaande beelden gelezen en bekeken; nieuwe resultaten gecontroleerd op inhoud, anatomie en leesbaarheid.

images.alt: Lesbeeld: oudere vrouwen leren jongeren — Titus 2:4; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Titus 2:3–5 instructs older women to teach what is good and train younger women in family love and self-control. Illustrative teaching scene, not a separately narrated named event: an elderly Christian woman conversing warmly with two younger adult women in a simple first-century Cretan courtyard beside domestic baskets and textiles. Three distinct fully clothed adults, attentive respectful expressions, gentle simple hand gestures, no readable scroll or exotic jewellery, no male preacher centered.

images.scene: Lesbeeld: Zenas en Apollos op weg
images.alt: Lesbeeld: Zenas en Apollos op weg — Titus 3:13; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Titus 3:13 instructs Titus to help Zenas the legal scholar and Apollos on their journey so they lack nothing. An illustrative enactment of the instruction: three adult men in a modest first-century Cretan courtyard, two travellers standing with small leather travel bags, one local believer giving a wrapped bread provision to one of the travellers while the other waits. Clear two travellers together, no invented legal trial, completed reunion with Paul or readable map. Natural hands and travel supplies, linen and wool clothing.
